source.mhfsdt: the game client's dat/mhfsdt.bin (not in our patch)
source.tools: hvmhfz_re d679c5c tools/weapons (weapons.py, moves.py, styles.py, move_names.py)

moves.name: Slash 1 (downslash)
moves.desc: Basic diagonal downslash, left-top to right-bottom (MV 20)

moves.name: Jump Slash, sword hit
moves.desc: Second hit of the Jump Slash (shield 13 then sword 21), also the unsheathe version; E/H/S code spawns it with record 179 (MV 21)

moves.name: Spin Slash
moves.desc: Body-spin sweep right to left, finisher; calc calls it Horizontal Slash (31); sigil Vacuum Slash adds an aura hit (16, no record found) (MV 31)
moves.input: Direction + Jump Double Slash button (Extreme); Spin Slash button (Earth)

moves.name: Guard Attack (guess)
moves.desc: Sweep from the guard stance (18, no KO, slash shape); the wiki says Extreme has no guard attack, yet action 3 of the Extreme table spawns this record (MV 18)

moves.name: Slash 2 (horizontal return slash)
moves.desc: Sideways slash returning from Slash 1; calc has "Slash 2" 14 for Earth/Heaven/Storm (older value), the client record has 26 (MV 26)

moves.name: Shield and Sword combo, shield hit
moves.desc: Shield strike of the "shield combo" after Slash 2 (10, KO 5); in Storm the same MV 10 is the thrust 2/3 value (MV 10)

moves.name: Shield and Sword combo, sword hit
moves.desc: Downslash ending the shield combo (16); Storm uses 13 + 16 for upslash + downslash (MV 16)

moves.name: Upslash
moves.desc: Upward slash from the right-bottom; reached from jump slash, evade, step and guard (MV 20)

moves.name: Upslash after a step (guess)
moves.desc: Upslash variant (action 12, two motions); same MV as record 30, placed by structure only (MV 20)
moves.input: Upslash button right after a step

moves.name: Jump Double Slash, hit 1
moves.desc: Rising slash of the jump double slash (26) (MV 26)

moves.name: Jump Double Slash, hit 2
moves.desc: Falling slash of the jump double slash (24) (MV 24)

moves.name: Slide Slash (guess)
moves.desc: MV 21 reached from five different states with the same motion 1429 (a move entered from anywhere, like the slide); could also be the sword hit of the dash jump slash (MV 21)

moves.name: Shield Attack (guess)
moves.desc: Shield swing, first part of Shield Attack and Shield Bash (13, KO 5); the Extreme dash jump slash (13 then 21) is the other candidate (MV 13)

moves.name: Shield Bash
moves.desc: Shield thrust ending Shield Attack and Bash (18, KO 10, launches allies) (MV 18)
moves.input: Shield Bash button after the Shield Attack

moves.name: Jump Slash, shield hit
moves.desc: First hit of the Jump Slash: shield slam (13, KO 5, ignores bounce); also the unsheathe Jump Slash (MV 13)

moves.name: Infinite Slash, slash A
moves.desc: 1st slash of the 3-slash infinite-slash cycle (25); numbering follows action order 23,24,25 (motions 1430,1431,1432) (MV 25)

moves.name: Infinite Slash, slash B
moves.desc: 2nd slash of the infinite-slash cycle (25) (MV 25)

moves.name: Infinite Slash, slash C
moves.desc: 3rd slash of the infinite-slash cycle (25) (MV 25)

moves.name: Jump Spin Slash (frontflip), hit 1
moves.desc: Extreme: forward flip with two slashes, first hit (18) (MV 18)
moves.input: Jump Spin Slash button, e.g. from the unsheathed dash (Extreme)

moves.name: Jump Spin Slash (frontflip), hit 2
moves.desc: Extreme: second slash of the frontflip (34) (MV 34)

moves.name: Evade Slash
moves.desc: Extreme: slash while stepping away with i-frames (17); calc lists the same MV as "Slash Down" for Earth/Heaven/Storm (MV 17)
moves.input: Evade button after an attack, in a direction (Extreme)

moves.name: Dash Shield Blow (aerial shield bash)
moves.desc: Extreme: spinning leap into a shield blow from the unsheathed dash (34, KO 22) (MV 34)
moves.input: Shield blow button during the unsheathed dash (Extreme)

moves.name: Shield Blow barrage, blow 1
moves.desc: Extreme: 1st blow of the repeating 3-blow shield barrage (20, KO 13); numbering by action order (MV 20)

moves.name: Shield Blow barrage, blow 2
moves.desc: Extreme: 2nd blow, backhand (20, KO 13) (MV 20)

moves.name: Shield Blow barrage, blow 3
moves.desc: Extreme: 3rd blow, uppercut (20, KO 13) (MV 20)
